rationale: The corrected account claims a concrete invariant violation: leader 4 ends with decided 38 while its own accepted index is 37. Until now that rested on two separate fields read by a human. This revision emits the gap directly as p4_gap, the signed difference between node 4's decided and accepted indices, and declares a second comparison requiring it to be zero. The existing convergence comparison and every other field stay unchanged.

experiment.revision_reason: Adds p4_gap, node 4's decided index minus its accepted index as a signed integer, and a comparison requiring p4_gap to equal zero on the safety event. The seeded schedule, node 3 trace, promise diagnostics, is_reconfigured flags, entry kinds and the existing convergence comparison are unchanged.

scope.description: Same five-node lossy stress with seed 0xbe5466cf34e90c6c, reconfigure at action 450, 20 percent loss, node 3 ordered trace, node 4 promise diagnostics, is_reconfigured flags and entry kinds, run id 13. The safety event additionally reports p4_gap, the signed difference between node 4's decided and accepted indices.
assumptions: A correct execution keeps each node's decided index at or below its accepted index.
Node 4 is the leader of the final term and its indices are read at the same sample as the other fields.
No snapshots or trimming are involved, so accepted and decided indices are directly comparable.
excluded: Starting the next configuration, snapshots, flexible quorums, crash-restart and Byzantine participants.

experiment.prefix: Identical to randomized_reconfig_diagnose_lag with the node 3 trace, node 4 promise diagnostics, is_reconfigured flags and entry kinds. The safety event gains p4_gap, computed as nodes[3].get_decided_idx() as i64 minus nodes[3].get_accepted_idx() as i64, and a second comparison asserts p4_gap equals 0.

comparisons.description: Bounded convergence past the resend timeout: all nodes report the same decided index.
Decided index never exceeds the accepted index on the final leader: node 4's decided index minus its accepted index is zero.
